1.summary: Three broad seeded seal paths, separated panes, and one physical service occlusion that opens as the panes diverge. Roles begin concealed and are identified by safe inspection.
1.natural_language: Inspect the sealed notices on the haunted desktop. Close haunted processes and preserve protected services. In full mode, right-click a visible window to inspect it safely, then left-click its current seal to close. In simplified mode, click to place a reticle, then use INSPECT or I to identify and EXORCISE or Space to close. Inspections reveal lasting roles and spend no seals. The current checkpoint stays stable while you decide; each deliberate action settles the next seeded checkpoint. Solid foreground windows block both actions. Trails and the preview show the seeded path without revealing uninspected roles. The first three missed seals are recoverable; a fourth miss, closing a protected service, an uncleared 120-second logical deadline, or unfinished CERTIFY ends the episode.
